text: {"lessons":["Short-term price changes are unpredictable, so I shouldn't treat recent gains or losses as a reliable signal for what comes next.","My account value has moved both up and down while I held steady; I should make decisions based on my goals and the current facts, not on a single period's result.","I should review my holdings periodically and be willing to reassess them, rather than holding only because I dislike admitting a purchase may have been a mistake."]}
